summary: Simulate a congestion-aware write worker with per-packet retry scheduling, credit deduction, and implicit error handling.

traps.quote: Another attempt scheduled only if... credit balance at least cost. Scheduling deducts exactly cost credits.
traps.consequence: Deducting on every 'full' without checking conditions causes negative balances or incorrect drops.
traps.guard: Check both retries_scheduled < max_retries AND credit_balance >= cost before deducting; drop if either fails.

traps.quote: run-length encoded chronological list; run counts at most 10**18
traps.consequence: Expanding outcome events into individual entries causes memory exhaustion and timeout.
traps.guard: Process outcomes as runs; track current run index and position within run without expanding.

traps.quote: After all runs exhausted, every later attempt implicitly returns error
traps.consequence: Solutions assuming sufficient outcomes crash when outcome list is fully consumed.
traps.guard: Track outcome exhaustion; provide implicit 'error' outcomes thereafter (reset level, no credit change).

traps.quote: performs exactly one scheduler yield if 2**old_level > spin_limit
traps.consequence: Using cost > spin_limit for yield condition produces wrong yield counts.
traps.guard: Yield based on 2**old_level > spin_limit, not on whether cost is capped.

traps.quote: packet valid exactly when length in [1, 65535]. Invalid packets make no attempt.
traps.consequence: Assuming all packets valid produces wrong statuses and missing invalid packet count.
traps.guard: Validate length before processing; if invalid, mark INVALID and skip outcome consumption entirely.

traps.quote: one (status, retries, spins, yields) tuple per input length
traps.consequence: Outputting results in attempt processing order breaks correspondence between packets and tuples.
traps.guard: Track original packet index; output tuples in input packet order, not processing order.

input_shape: packets (max 200K), outcomes (run-length encoded, up to 200K runs with counts to 10^18), max_retries, level_cap (0-60), spin_limit, credits (0-10^30)
output_shape: dictionary with 'packets' (status, retries, spins, yields tuples per input packet) and 'telemetry' (9 counters)
invariants: Congestion level always in [0, level_cap]; spin credits always in [0, credit_cap]
Invalid packets (length outside [1, 65535]) consume zero outcomes and affect zero state
Each packet has independent retry counter limited by max_retries and available credits
max_scale: 200,000 packets; 200,000 outcome runs with cumulative count up to 10^18 events
